candidates.desc: The ultimate harness for coding agents and beyond. All your agents. All your machines. One command center. Start with code, then follow your curiosity and build across disciplines: CAD, circuits, robots, games and music.

Open-source home design and floor plan editor in Rust (a Sweet Home 3D alternative) with a built-in MCP server: your AI agent draws walls, furnishes rooms, checks lighting and ergonomics, and renders photos — live, on your own machine.
Open-source NURBS surface modeller — a Rhino-style freeform modeller on the OpenCASCADE kernel, with AI-native MCP integration
Convert STL/OBJ/PLY meshes into editable CAD (STEP + parametric CadQuery/OpenSCAD/FreeCAD) with primitive fitting. CLI + MCP server
Draw an outline. Pull it up. Open-source push/pull 3D modeler in Rust: desktop app, CLI and MCP server.
SketchUp MCP + Skill for AI modeling: managed Ruby transactions, geometry readback, source-image review and local edits. Codex/PipClaw on Windows.
中国专利附图 Skill：从 3D 装配体（STEP）一步出符合国家知识产权局形式要求的说明书附图。自动标号与引线、13 项质检、PDF/Word/DXF 导出，支持 Skill / MCP / CLI，本地运行。

【Every star you give feeds a hungry developer's motivation! ⭐️】Floor plans as code. Your AI writes ArchLang; the compiler draws a precise, dimensioned plan (SVG, DXF, PDF) and tells it what's wrong. Open source, MIT.
MCP server bridging AI assistants to CATIA Magic / Cameo Systems Modeler for SysML/UML model creation, querying, and manipulation
CATIA automation REST API · Modular modeling · AI-driven design · Swagger docs · JWT auth · Async tasks
Scientific rover built through SolidCraft MCP: editable CAD, website and splash artwork, videos, and a reproducible performance workload.
MCP server that lets AI agents build, measure and verify parametric parts and assemblies in a running SolidWorks (Windows, COM).
The CAD runtime built for AI agents: 2D drawings (DXF/DWG) and parametric 3D parts (FreeCAD, STEP) through MCP, CLI and Python, with undo, independent validation and a live viewer.

Remote control solution for Fusion 360 using client-server architecture. Features JSON socket communication, modular design with Python server and client library, plus Fusion 360 add-in. Enables command monitoring, remote execution, and model data retrieval for automation workflows.
Ever wanted Claude to do your CAD for you?
Local-first, open-source mechanical CAD

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for SolidWorks, enabling AI assistants to interact with CAD models, automate design workflows, and bridge LLMs with SolidWorks API. 基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的 SolidWorks 适配器，使 AI 助手能够直接操作、分析和自动化 SolidWorks 建模流程。
Packaged SolidWorks MCP server for Codex and local stdio deployment

Agent-driven hardware design tool for ESP32 and ESP8266 devices: firmware for ESPHome, Tasmota, WLED, LoRaWAN, Meshtastic, CircuitPython and MicroPython, plus KiCad schematic/PCB, a printable enclosure and a BOM.

You specify it, you build it. A workshop where a sentence becomes a validated build program, an exact solid, a measured report and a STEP, DXF, STL or URDF file. Any OpenAI-compatible model; agents over MCP.
fusion360-mcp
Agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other agents: turns a building brief into a checked concept design with CAD drawings (DXF, PDF), a furnished 3D model and an exact area schedule.

This is a repo I will be updating from time to time with skills for Claude to model in SolidCraft, right now the skills focus on going around the limitations that come with Solidcraft still being in Beta. Almost every feature is listed in these skills.
MCP server giving AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) full control over Rhinoceros 3D v8 — 105 tools for geometry, surfaces, booleans, Grasshopper, viewport capture, and script execution
C# plugins for Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate (PDPS): robotic welding, path planning, reachability checks, CATIA/Excel export, AI agent and MCP. 机器人焊接仿真与二次开发插件集。

Turn STEP CAD files into AI-readable context packs: exact dimensions, holes, cutouts, fasteners, assembly relations, joints, weak spots and labelled images. Runs offline. Works with any AI chat, Claude Code (plugin), Copilot and MCP clients.

We taught Claude how to drive Fusion 360. Sketches, extrusions, assemblies, exports—all through natural language. The hard part wasn't the code, it was getting Claude to understand where things go in 3D space. The skill files capture everything we figured out so it just works.

AI agent for Siemens Tecnomatix Process Simulate (PDPS): scene tools, C#/Python automation, robot reachability, BASE0 checks, reusable recipes and CATIA/Excel workflows. 进程内 AI 助手与工程自动化。
AI-powered bridge for Rhino 3D and Grasshopper via the Model Context Protocol

Plugin host and management plane for Creo Parametric 6.0. Mount, update and roll back Pro/TOOLKIT plugins at runtime; every capability is a schema-validated, risk-gated command with audit, plus an MCP bridge for AI assistants. Unofficial, Apache-2.0.
AgInTi LabCanvas: agentic studio for editable scientific figures, CAD devices, and experiment design.

Bring Claude Code and any MCP agent to your live SysML v1 models in CATIA Magic: 130+ tools to query, audit, and edit the real model over a local, air-gapped connection. No cloud, no export. FREE / PRO / ENTERPRISE.

Plugin host and management plane for Creo Parametric 6.0. Mount, update and roll back Pro/TOOLKIT plugins at runtime; every capability is a schema-validated, risk-gated command with audit, plus an MCP bridge for AI assistants. Unofficial, Apache-2.0.

3D model creation for AI agents — MCP server + agent skill: 6 geometry engines (procedural, image, OpenSCAD, Blender, CadQuery, hosted), 15 equation-defined shape families, a procedural planet generator, profile-based validation, and a single-file Three.js viewer. Text-to-3D providers: Meshy, Tripo, Rodin.

Full-stack offline CATIA V5 knowledge engine & MCP Server for AI Agents: fused COM API, version-aligned User's Guide, CATNls settings, samples & win32com recipes (BYOD, SQLite FTS5). 面向 AI Agent 的 CATIA V5 全栈离线知识引擎与 MCP Server：融合 COM API、离线手册、CATNls 选项、官方样板与 win32com 实战配方。

18 free, read-only SysML v1 analysis skills for CATIA Magic (MSOSA): navigate, inspect, audit, and report via /jgs-v1 over the jgs-magic-sysmlv1-mcp bridge. Works with ZCode, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot, and Cursor.
MCP server for Rhino 3D: 105 tools for AI-driven 3D modelling, analysis, diagnostics and Grasshopper integration. Use with Claude.
MCP bridge for PTC Creo Parametric via Creoson + creopyson
Vendor-neutral AgentSkills for CAD/CAM review, manufacturing planning, and evidence-backed handoffs across CNC milling, FDM printing, and laser cutting with explicit safety and human-review gates.
Verified automation lanes for AI agents to drive COMSOL, Abaqus & Creo — Python + MCP, built-in guardrails, judge keywords and smoke tests.
Local-first multimodal CAD agent: photos, sketches & text in — verified, parametric, manufacturing-ready 3D models out (build123d, voxel FEM, topology optimization, MCP). Self-hosted, AGPLv3.
Open-source AI email client for Windows – Outlook alternative with STEP, DXF/DWG, PDF, Office & CNC viewers, local AI (Ollama) and MCP
Control Rhino 3D from Claude, Cursor, Codex — 358 tools: geometry, Grasshopper, V-Ray, Enscape, BIM, AI generation
Read and check the GD&T (semantic PMI) in STEP AP242 files: inspection characteristic lists, ballooned PDF reports, MCP server. Pure Python, fully local.
Millimeter 2D CAD workbench, analytical manufacturing DRC verifier, and Open CASCADE 3D STEP bridge (+ chamfer-mcp)
Reusable Claude Code skills for builders: Figma MCP design/build, Fusion 360 CAD, LangGraph agents, LangSmith evals, After Effects ExtendScript.

A practical FreeCAD + MCP pipeline for parametric 3D design: code-built models, geometry verification, and DfAM/DFM checks for 3D printing, CNC, and laser cutting.
3D CAD Converter MCP server + skill for AI agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, VS Code...) on Windows: convert STEP, IGES, STL, OBJ, glTF on local files

Watch the 13 ArtCraft apps build for real: one page per Craft app, every demo streams live CLI steps into real artifacts (DXF/PDF, DOCX, XLSX, MP4, WAV) with an optional local-LLM step. Hands-in playback, hands-out files. MCP server + webapp.

Claude Code skill that reads DWG on Windows without AutoCAD (GNU LibreDWG + ezdxf) and extracts the drawing inventory as JSON - layouts, viewports with scale, layers, blocks, title block, texts and dimensions - plus the DXF conversion.
Claude skill: turn any idea, photo or broken STL into a print-ready, verified 3D model. No CAD skills needed.

Production Model Context Protocol (MCP) & desktop CAD/GIS/Design automation suite (7 bridges: QGIS, Rhino 3D, Grasshopper, Rhino-Alias, Components-Log, Illustrator, Figma) for any AI coding agent (cloud, IDE, CLI, or local LLM) • Selected for the XERJ Corpus Hub
中文 Codex 技能集：Creo 原生建模、曲面设计、参数编辑、排障与 TOOLKIT 开发，另含独立 Windows 屏幕观察闭环。Creo 后端需单独部署。简单建模可以做到，无论是通过二维工程图描述还是自然语言口述，复杂类型的曲面还是不行。
Open-source parametric CAD with a familiar layout and a built-in MCP server, so AI agents can design parts while you watch. Reads SOLIDWORKS, STEP, IGES and Parasolid files.

Open-source CNC manufacturing intelligence, feature inspection and parametric cycles for SolidCraft.

Turn STEP, BREP and IGES files into drawings, photorealistic renders, animations and videos, from Claude or any MCP client.

Make Parts Now (MakePartsNow.com) plugin for Claude: instant 3D printing and CNC machining quotes and orders from your CAD files (STL, STEP).
Laser cutting API and MCP server for AI agents: price a DXF or SVG in acrylic, wood or Delrin and get a payment link. No account, no API key.
